subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission options and template questions
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@cedarhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-12-07T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission options and template questions

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for starting onboarding with Redwood. Two quick items we need to lock down to get you fully activated for payment:

1) Invoice intake channel: we support our vendor portal (recommended) or email submission. For the pilot we can accept emailed invoices, but we ask for a standardized subject token and filename convention to support automation.
2) Invoice template / minimal required fields: PO number stamping, remit-to, line-item unit prices, tax lines, and a single total. I attached our vendor onboarding form and a compact sample invoice template to show the exact columns we parse.

Attachments: vendor-onboarding-form.pdf (stub), sample-invoice-template.csv (stub)

Could you confirm:
- Whether CedarHealth prefers portal or email for go-live?
- If email, can you adopt the subject token format: RedwoodPO-<PO_NUMBER>-CEDAR (example: RedwoodPO-4523-CEDAR)?
- Do you require PO stamping on the invoice or just referencing the PO number in the body?

If portal is acceptable, we can kick off a 1-week pilot and I’ll share the portal onboarding checklist. If email, we’ll provide a sample subject, filename rules, and a quick QA step with ops to ensure mapping.

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync today or tomorrow to confirm approach and timelines.

Thanks —
Connor O'Brien
Vendor Success Lead
Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198

--
Redwood Inference — production-first inference platform
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@cedarhealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure@cedarhealth.com
Date: 2027-12-07T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission options and template questions

Connor —

Appreciate the clear checklist. Quick answers from our side:

- For now, CedarHealth would like to start with email submission while we evaluate the portal. Email gives our AP team time to align the internal ERP.
- We can add the subject token in the requested format (RedwoodPO-<PO_NUMBER>-CEDAR). That is fine.
- We normally include PO numbers in the invoice header and sometimes apply PO stamping; for automated intake please assume PO numbers will be present in the top of the document, but we may not physically stamp every PDF.

I attached a sample invoice we send to other vendors so you can see our typical layout. We need to confirm you can parse multi-line descriptions and the way we present tax lines.

Attachment: cedar_health_invoice_sample.pdf (stub)

Some constraints from our side: payment terms are Net 45 by default with our finance approvals. Also, our filenames today include the vendor name and invoice number (CEDAR_Invoice_20271201_10023.pdf). If you need a rename step on ingestion, let us know.

Happy to do a 30-minute call this afternoon.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Vendor Relations Manager
CedarHealth LLC
alicia@cedarhealth.com | +1 617-555-4482

Date: 2027-12-07T15:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission options and template questions

Thanks, Alicia — very clear. A couple operational clarifications from Redwood procurement so the go-live is smooth:

- PO handling: Redwood requires the PO number to be present on the invoice for automated matching. Physical stamping is not mandatory, but the PO must be in the invoice header or as the first line of text. If your system occasionally omits the PO on certain PDFs, please include it in the email subject token as a fallback. Example subject we will accept for automated parsing: "RedwoodPO-4523-CEDAR".

- Filename conventions: ideal filename is "Redwood_Invoice_<INVOICE_NUM>_CEDAR.pdf" but we can accept your current pattern and perform a rename during intake. Please expect a short validation window (15–30 minutes) where ops will confirm the mapping; in rare cases we may ask for a corrected file.

- Invoice fields we must be able to parse: invoice number, invoice date (YYYY-MM-DD), PO number, remit-to name/address, line items with unit cost and quantity, tax per line (or a single tax line), and invoice total. Multi-line descriptions are fine as long as unit price and quantity are on the same row.

- Pilot plan: since you prefer email, let’s do a 5-business-day pilot window starting Wednesday 2027-12-08. During that window we’ll route your invoices to the email ingestion queue and share a short QA report each afternoon. If metrics look good (match rate > 95%), we’ll mark you fully activated and share portal invites for long-term use.

Attached: portal-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (stub)

Can you confirm: 1) pilot start date works, and 2) we can expect your first three pilot invoices to be labeled with the subject token? If yes, I’ll schedule the QA channel and notify Ops.

Thanks for the quick turnaround.

—Jordan Blake
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-3221
